name: RippleEmitter
src_typeComment: Drop this on ANY GameObject whose Renderer uses a shader that includes RippleInclude.cginc — every shader in Rendering/Water/ (Realistic, Stylized, 2D) already does. It drives the shared _RippleImpacts array via a MaterialPropertyBlock, so it never touches (or needs to know) which specific shader is assigned: dragging this same component onto a Stylized-water object instead of a Realistic-water one "just works", because the two shaders agree on the same property names rather than knowing about each other or about this component.

src_serialized.name: rippleSpeed
src_serialized.tooltip: World units/second the ring expands outward.

src_serialized.name: rippleWidth
src_serialized.tooltip: Thickness of the expanding ring, in world units.

src_serialized.name: rippleLifetime
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds before a ripple fully fades out.

src_members.sig: public int ActiveImpactCount { get; private set; }
src_members.name: ActiveImpactCount
AddImpact
src_members.comment: Call this from a footstep event, a rain droplet spawner, a TriggerEventRelay.OnEnter — anything that has a world position and a moment something touched the water. Impacts are stored in a ring buffer: once more than MaxRipples land within one lifetime, the OLDEST slot is silently reused rather than the array growing unbounded.
